questions.stem: CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂. What mass of calcium oxide is produced from 25 g of calcium carbonate? (Ar: Ca = 40, C = 12, O = 16)
questions.explanation: Mr of CaCO₃ = 40 + 12 + 48 = 100. Moles of CaCO₃ = 25/100 = 0.25 mol. The ratio is 1:1, so moles of CaO = 0.25 mol. Mr of CaO = 40 + 16 = 56. Mass = 0.25 × 56 = 14 g.
